notes: Verified kobuki#207 and its two comments. Eligible at step 6: the provider's xacro expands to a <robot> that never instantiates the <kobuki/> macro, so the robot_description value the consumer parses contains no <link>; the resolution creates a new model artifact, not a name binding, so not deployment_wiring. Class disagreement: representation_convention covers component/byte order, handedness, or encoding of a crossing value; an expanded model that is structurally empty for this consumer (no link elements) is none of those, and the spec's own notes state 'Classification other is used because the provided value is structurally empty for this consumer', contradicting its class field. Proposed class: other. Element param:robot_description is right. Loudness loud_documented/activate agreed: the consumer emits errors naming the cause and dies at node start-up (a launch/activation-stage diagnostic). Resolution recommended agreed: the maintainer added the standalone xacro and the commit closes #207, but the thread never shows the viewer running with the new launcher.
